_comment: Frozen 62-symbol input vocabulary of the sanoTTS vocos voices (heart, heartnano).
It is the trained model's input interface: symbol -> integer id, as embedded in the
Trellis-RIFT checkpoint's frontend metadata. Reproduced here as data, not code: it is
what the weights were trained against, so any other assignment produces wrong audio.
Override with --vocos-vocabulary if a future pack ships its own table.
unicode_note: A=eI, I=aI, O=oU, W=aU, Y=OI, T=flap; misaki's diphthong shorthands.
